header:
# Town of Fayston municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 9; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists three Fayston Selectboard members: Chuck Martel (Chair), Mike Jordan (Vice Chair), and Ron Graves.

Town of Fayston 2026 Town Report (faystonvt.com), printing the minutes of the March 4, 2025 annual meeting and the 2026 Warning: the March 2025 minutes record Martel re-elected to a three-year term; the June 2026 directory seats all three after the March 2026 meeting.

Town of Fayston 2026 Town Report (faystonvt.com), printing the minutes of the March 4, 2025 annual meeting and the 2026 Warning: Madison Vasseur was elected in March 2025 to fill the remainder of Patti Lewis's term, ending 2026; the 2026 Warning (Art. 3) stood the office for a new three-year term and no outcome is published. Structure only.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Madison Vasseur as Fayston Town Clerk (January 2026).

Town of Fayston 2026 Town Report (faystonvt.com), printing the minutes of the March 4, 2025 annual meeting and the 2026 Warning: Sarah Stavraky was elected in March 2025 to fill a term ending 2026; the office stood in 2026 and no outcome is published. Structure only.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Sarah Stavraky as Fayston Town Treasurer (January 2026).

Town of Fayston 2026 Town Report (faystonvt.com), printing the minutes of the March 4, 2025 annual meeting and the 2026 Warning: Sarah Stavraky was re-elected Collector of Delinquent Taxes in March 2025 for one year; the office stood in 2026 and no outcome is published. Structure only.

Town of Fayston 2026 Town Report (faystonvt.com), printing the minutes of the March 4, 2025 annual meeting and the 2026 Warning: Rick Rayfield was re-elected Moderator in March 2025 for one year; the office stood in 2026 and no outcome is published. Structure only.

Town of Fayston 2026 Town Report (faystonvt.com), printing the minutes of the March 4, 2025 annual meeting and the 2026 Warning: the 2025 minutes record Kim Laidlaw re-elected to a three-year term; Doug Mosle's seat appears in neither the 2025 nor the 2026 Warning, so he continues; Kirsten Andreae's seat stood in 2026 and its outcome is unpublished, so it is left unfilled.

Town of Fayston 2026 Town Report (faystonvt.com), printing the minutes of the March 4, 2025 annual meeting and the 2026 Warning: Chris Griffin was re-elected Second Constable in March 2025 for one year; the office stood in 2026 and no outcome is published. Structure only. No First Constable article appears in either the 2025 minutes or the 2026 Warning, so no First Constable post is created.

Town of Fayston 2026 Town Report (faystonvt.com), printing the minutes of the March 4, 2025 annual meeting and the 2026 Warning: the town elects one cemetery commissioner yearly to a three-year term, fixing the commission at three seats: David Koepele was re-elected in March 2025 and Karen Sauther was elected in March 2025 to a remainder ending 2027; Candace Porter's seat stood in 2026, outcome unpublished, left unfilled.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Fayston justices of the peace: Peter Forbes, Jared Cadwell, Cynthia Seckler, Fedrick Rayfield, and Danielle Dukette.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the SOS listing names the five Fayston winners of the November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election. The listing's 'Fedrick Rayfield' is NOT merged with Fayston's Moderator Rick Rayfield: the name form alone is not a second fact.
